testcase.name: conventional and public CWL-shaped POST forms fill once without submission
explicit username phase fills only that field
explicit password phase fills only that field
username-first and password-only need explicit autocomplete semantics
focus-only requires the actual nonnull eligible input
only top-level exact HTTPS origin can offer or fill
GET, cross-origin, credential-bearing action URLs and external targets are rejected
readonly, disabled and disabled-fieldset credential controls never offer or fill
OTP and new-password inputs are never treated as current login credentials
multiple visible usernames or passwords fail closed
hidden decoys are not selected and visible replacement ambiguity is rejected
covered, transparent, hidden, inert and offscreen fields are not actionable
a nonempty password suppresses offers and cannot be overwritten after offering
changed human username is preserved and consumes the offer
existing matching username is allowed but a different typed account is preserved
disconnected and replaced bound nodes cannot receive saved credentials
reparented form and document identities cannot be rebound
same-origin action path and field semantics changes invalidate the offer
both original values are set before page input handlers can replace destinations
page input and change handlers resetting either bound value prevent a success claim
page handlers detaching or reparenting the bound form or fields prevent a success claim
native prototype setter is used and fixed output never includes credentials
safe native offer metadata does not serialize the retained username or DOM
empty password and malformed credential arguments fail before setters
